## History

Flora Jane is a member of Mrs. Blewett's household who is noted for her bad temper and small size. When Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) considers taking in [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to help care for her children, she specifically mentions that Flora Jane's temperament requires extra assistance with the family.
